eps.ov: Years after the battle with Earth's greatest enemy, Majin Buu, the planet's savior Son Goku spends his days in peace. Meanwhile, on a distant planet, the God of Destruction Beerus awakens from his long slumber!

eps.t: The God of Destruction Heads to the Planet of the Kai
eps.ov: Elder Supreme Kai and Supreme Kai Kibito learn of the awakening of the almighty Beerus. Meanwhile, the God of Destruction heads to the Planet of the Kai to find out about the "Super Saiyan God" he saw in a prophetic dream and...?!

eps.t: The God of Destruction Heads to Earth
eps.ov: After facing off with Goku, Beerus heads to Earth seeking other Saiyans. On Earth, Goku's companions have gathered to celebrate Bulma's birthday. When Vegeta sees Beerus, the terror of the God of Destruction resurfaces in his mind...!
When Beerus threatens to destroy Earth over a minor dispute, Goku devises a plan to summon the dragon Shenron and learn the secret required to achieve the Super Saiyan God transformation.

eps.t: The God of Destruction and Son Goku
eps.ov: With everyone's help, Goku transforms into a "Super Saiyan God"! With Earth's fate on the line, the fierce battle between Goku with his unknown god powers and the God of Destruction Beerus begins!

In the "Battle of Gods" between the Super Saiyan God and the God of Destruction, Goku loses his god powers. Against Beerus and his overwhelming strength, Goku faces absolute peril! How will this ultimate battle over Earth's fate end...?!

Though Earth was spared from Beerus's destruction thanks to Goku's efforts, a new threat approaches...! The remnants of the Frieza Force head to Earth in search of the Dragon Balls for one purpose... to resurrect Frieza!
